facts.fact: The storm caught Ila and Kunal about an hour east of the shelf above the Drum. The fold of shore under the Drum, where the lower lake huts stand (F537), was already drifting shut behind them, so they went on west over the shoulder to Dhanu's upper hut above the Mirror (F515), the nearest shelter they could still reach. Revises F714.

At the door Kunal pulls off his gloves to show Ila his fingertips, grey and blistered with frostnip from the lie-cold he took off her in ch 15 (F533); they are not yet dead. He says 'That's what your last lie cost me, and I'd pay it again.' Replaces F715; the dead tips come only from the broken promise in ch 21 (F555).

When Kunal asks 'Is my family in your letter?', Ila refuses to answer but truthfully admits she asked about Udai for a reason she cannot give; her fingertips stay pink. Kunal reads the question as not idle and takes the refusal 'as it stands, not as a yes'.
